notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – First Update Since "Steven" Release!
notes.content:
🛠 Patch Notes – First Update Since "Steven" Release!

Hello everyone!

We’re excited to bring you the first major update since the release of "Steven"! This update introduces several new features, improvements, and quality-of-life changes based on your feedback.

✨ New Features & Additions


🎮 Controller support added for a smoother gameplay experience.
🎵 New music track to enhance the atmosphere.
🏆 New achievement: "Labor Force" — can you unlock it?
🌍 Translations now available in:

Russian (ru)
Polish (pl)
Portuguese – Portugal (pt-PT)
Portuguese – Brazil (pt-BR)
Spanish (es)
Chinese (zh)
French (fr)
German (de)
Turkish (tr)
Japanese (jp)
Korean (kr)
Italian (it)



🧩 User Interface Improvements


🧩 Upgrade menu redesigned for better usability.
⇧ Hold Shift in-game to quickly open the upgrade menu.
📊 Leaderboard interface updated for improved clarity and style.


🛠 Gameplay Tools


🛠️ Cheat mode options are now available for testing and fun.


🔁 Balance & Mechanics


🌀 The "Featherstorm" upgrade now triggers automatically for smoother gameplay flow.


Thanks for playing and supporting the game — more updates are on the way!

– The Dev Team
